Note to the operator: name, address and email are still missing. Please enter them as administrator under “Legal notice & privacy”.
User account: user name and password (stored only as a salted hash, never in plain text), role, date of creation.
Content you create: decks, collection, wishlist, folders, game log, game nights with the names of the players, comments and ratings in the deck gallery, settings.

Login: a session cookie (cdbsess), technically necessary to keep you logged in (§ 25 (2) No. 2 TDDDG). To protect against password guessing, the IP address is briefly kept in memory after failed logins.
Local storage in the browser: view settings and ongoing test games (localStorage); these never leave your device.
Game night links: anyone who has the link or QR code of a game night sees the players' names, the tables and the standings and can enter results.

Scryfall (Scryfall, LLC, USA): card images are loaded directly from Scryfall's servers; Scryfall receives your IP address and browser data in the process. The server fetches card data without any personal data.
Links to sellers (Cardmarket, Trader-online, cardcosmos): data is only transmitted to the seller when you click; the seller's privacy policy applies.
